label: Prices and plans
description: A side-by-side comparison of what you offer and what it costs.

fields.name: columns
fields.label: Columns
fields.help: How many plans sit side by side on a wide screen.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price
fields.help: The figure exactly as you want it read, for example £450, from £1,200, or On request.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Who it is for
fields.help: One line saying who should pick this plan.

fields.name: features
fields.label: What is included
fields.help: One line per item. These become a list, not a paragraph.

fields.name: emphasis
fields.label: Highlight this plan
fields.help: Featured marks one plan as the one you recommend.

fields.name: buttonLabel
fields.label: Button label
fields.help: Wording for the button below the plans, for example Ask for a quote. The button only appears when both this and the button link are filled in.

fields.name: buttonUrl
fields.label: Button link
fields.help: One of your own pages as a path like /contact, or a full web address.
